noChartAttached.where: Print dialog: missing-charts list, reason under a song title

me.where: Print dialog: personalized option, shown when the user has no display name

capoFret.where: Print dialog: personalized option detail, the user's capo position

emailNotSaved.where: Print dialog: error toast when emailing before the setlist is saved

emailSelectRecipient.where: Print dialog: error toast when no email recipient is selected

emailSendFailed.where: Print dialog: error toast when the email request fails

emailSent.where: Print dialog: success toast after emailing packet links
emailSent.context: {count} is the number of musicians emailed; a packet is the printable set of charts

emailFailedCount.where: Print dialog: warning toast when some emails failed
emailFailedCount.context: {count} is the number of failed emails

emailPacketsFailed.where: Print dialog: error toast (fallback) when emailing fails

progressGenerating.where: Print dialog: progress message while the PDF is built

progressPackets.where: Print dialog: progress message while building one packet per musician

progressZipping.where: Print dialog: progress message while building the ZIP file

generateFailed.where: Print dialog: error message when the PDF cannot be built

missingChartsTitle.where: Print dialog: warning heading when songs are missing their chart
missingChartsTitle.context: {count} is the number of songs without a chart; chart = the sheet-music file

missingChartsLeftOutEmail.where: Print dialog: missing-charts warning, first sentence when emailing
missingChartsLeftOutEmail.context: count = number of missing charts (only chooses this/these)

missingChartsLeftOutDownload.where: Print dialog: missing-charts warning, first sentence when downloading
missingChartsLeftOutDownload.context: count = number of missing charts (only chooses this/these)

missingChartsRepairHint.where: Print dialog: missing-charts warning, second sentence
missingChartsRepairHint.context: count = number of missing charts; an omission notice is a page in the packet listing the missing charts

noActiveMusicians.where: Print dialog: email step empty state

whatToPrint.where: Print dialog: label above the Setlist Only / Full Packet switch

setlistOnly.where: Print dialog: option to print just the song list (one page)

fullPacket.where: Print dialog: option to print the song list plus every chart

headerDetails.where: Print dialog: label above the title/date/event fields printed on the cover

headerTitle.where: Print dialog: title field placeholder and label

headerDate.where: Print dialog: date field placeholder and label

headerEvent.where: Print dialog: event field placeholder and label

cancel.where: Print dialog: Cancel button (missing-charts and email steps)

continueWithout.where: Print dialog: button that prints anyway, leaving missing charts out
continueWithout.context: {count} is the number of missing charts

sendEmails.where: Print dialog: email step confirm button

downloadZip.where: Print dialog: main button when several musicians' packets are zipped

emailPacketLinks.where: Print dialog: button that emails each musician a link to their packet

printFor.where: Print dialog: label above the audience choices

modeGeneric.where: Print dialog: audience option, untransposed charts
modeGeneric.context: Concert pitch = charts as written, not transposed for an instrument

modeGenericHint.where: Print dialog: hint beside the generic option

modeJustMe.where: Print dialog: audience option, transposed for the signed-in musician's instrument

modePerMusician.where: Print dialog: audience option, one transposed packet per chosen musician

selectedCount.where: Print dialog: number of musicians chosen

selectedCountZip.where: Print dialog: number of musicians chosen, when they will be zipped together
selectedCountZip.context: {count} is the number of musicians; '→ ZIP' means the packets come as one ZIP file (use ← in a right-to-left language)

selectAll.where: Print dialog: link that selects every musician

deselectAll.where: Print dialog: link that clears the musician selection

statSongs.where: Print dialog summary: label for the number of songs

statOutput.where: Print dialog summary: label for what will be printed

statOutputCoverOnly.where: Print dialog summary: value when only the song list is printed

statPdfsIncluded.where: Print dialog summary: label for the number of charts included

statTransposed.where: Print dialog summary: label for the number of transposed songs

songsWithoutPdfs.where: Print dialog summary: warning about songs that have no chart PDF
songsWithoutPdfs.context: {count} is the number of songs; English keeps 'song(s)' for every count, translate with a correct plural

include.where: Print dialog, full packet: label before the All/None buttons

includeAll.where: Print dialog, full packet: include every chart

includeNone.where: Print dialog, full packet: include no charts

transposeLabel.where: Print dialog, full packet: label before the semitone buttons

transposeReset.where: Print dialog, full packet: reset every song's transposition

transposeTrack.where: Print dialog, full packet: per-song transpose control (screen-reader label)

transposeDown.where: Print dialog, full packet: minus button (screen-reader label)

transposeUp.where: Print dialog, full packet: plus button (screen-reader label)

songsWillBeTransposed.where: Print dialog, full packet: note under the song list

chordsDetectedNote.where: Print dialog, full packet: explanation after the transposed-songs count
